_schema: Video/post-derived observations of what tools, components and software a Russian drone maker uses or shows in its own promo/instructional material. One entry per observation. evidence: bom_text (component list in the post text), caption, spoken (transcript), on_screen (identified visually). confidence: stated (the maker names it) | seen (identified from footage, not stated) | inferred. verbatim_ru is exact source text and null when the evidence is only visual. A hit is a lead until checked against the primary post. Feed confirmed items into entities.json foreign_components[] / marketing_claims[] via corrections files.

observations.item: Airframe must be loaded 550-700 g, weight forward
observations.verbatim_ru: Дрон нужно загружать 550-700гр, вес максимально смещаем ближе к голове, для лучшей развесовки, без веса он не летает!
observations.note: CORRECTION: the channel's own earlier posts state the warhead weight as 500-700 g (31.05.2025, s5475: «Вес боевой части в представленной модели 500-700 граммов») and a 500 g cylinder with a fragmentation warhead (s5454). The 550-700 g load here is in the same range, so it is very likely the warhead; this post itself does not say so.
observations.registry_status: CORRECTION: the registry already carries a sourced marketing claim (s5454, 2026-06-26) that the combat version uses a cylinder with a warhead (fragments: balls or lock nuts), 500 g. The 550-700 g load here is consistent with that; the cylinder/canister in the print files is therefore probably that warhead container. Still an inference from two sources, not a statement in this post.

observations.item: Speaker self-identifies by callsign «Радистка»: SVO since 2022, strike-drone operator since 2023, serving in a UAS-troops unit, recruiting on the school's behalf
observations.note: Whisper (small) transcript, approximate; garbled words read as: 'мой позывной Радистка', 'соратники', 'школа БПЛА Архангел'. Gist as transcribed: 'Здравствуйте, дорогие жители Краснодара и Краснодарского края. Я ваша землячка ... На специальной военной операции нахожусь с 2022 года и с 2023 года являюсь оператором ударных беспилотных аппаратов ... были созданы войска беспилотных систем. В одном из таких подразделений мы сейчас находимся со своей командой ... Приходите к нам ... обратиться в школу БПЛА Архангел. Там вы получите помощь в заходе к нам на контракт с максимальными выплатами.' Same callsign as the operator in post 7815 (1-я Славянская бригада 51-й армии, received 10 drop systems) and @rastratchikRadistka; that the speaker is that operator is inferred from the callsign, not stated in the clip. Callsign only; no real name recorded. Existing registry/notes already track «Радистка» (gagaring_network_map.md, my_el_lab msg 1242).
observations.registry_status: PARTLY KNOWN: callsign appears in gagaring_network_map.md and an entity note; the recruiting-video statement itself is new.
observations.wired: 2026-09-19: image (s7645) + open_questions[] (no people.json record: only a callsign is sourced) on proekt-kb-arkhangel

observations.item: Press report (not the maker's own promo): Пиранья FPV drones described as operating on frequencies the enemy cannot jam; footage shows video degrading under interference while the drone keeps flying and hits small targets
observations.note: On-screen captions (exact): «Атака «Пираньи»»; «Новые российские FPV-дроны начали охоту на технику ВСУ»; «Средства РЭБ противника не способны заглушить наши беспилотники». Narration via whisper base, approximate: 'Главное их преимущество — это работа на частотах, которые враги просто не могут глушить. Естественно, всех нюансов инженеры не раскрывают.' No component, radio or flight-controller make is named; the frequency band is not stated. Footage is FPV with a yellow-nosed airframe. The maker embeds this clip on its own homepage (WEBCAPTURE_7300024069_20260825_piranhafpv-ru-homepage.html), so it is used as a promo asset.
observations.registry_status: Not yet checked against the Пиранья record's marketing_claims[] (s1411, s1410).
